messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point

message.content:
At a pressure of **10 kPa** (≈0.1 atm) water freezes at roughly **–2 °C**.  
In fact, the freezing point of water drops to about –2.2 °C at 10 kPa, as shown by the water phase diagram and experimental data.
